There are 5 separate easter celebrations

We only do the 1st Mardi Gras and Ash Wednesday 

Counting of the Omer is 49 days after passover. applied to easter, 7 weeks after the determined Easter. Shauvot is Pentecost effctively.  

== Jewish holidays ==
Shauvot == Pentecost

Purim == 30 days before Easter
